Design Team An IDT team has been appointed for the project, the full Project Team members are as follows: SELECTION CRITERIA Works Contractor Suitability The Contracting Authority is seeking a contractor capable of delivering the new works within a live operational fire station campus. Applicants will need to demonstrate experience of working in a live environment and managing working within this environment successfully. Suitability Assessment Process The objective of this is to identify and evaluate Applicants’ that meet the technical and financial capacity, and then to qualitatively assess and rank those who meet the minimum standards. The minimum standards for the assessment criteria are set out in the SAQ documents. An Applicant which fails to achieve these minimum standards will not be given further consideration and the Applicant will be excluded from the competition. The process used in assessing submissions is set out below: Elimination Criteria Initially the Applicant’s personal situation declaration (Appendix A) is reviewed. Scope of Works The proposed project comprises constructing a new two-storey training building (gross internal floor area 700 sqm approx.), alterations to the BA building & new training tower, new storage shed & gas compound and upgrade works to external yard. The site is a brownfield site (adjacent to existing dwellings). The proposed new building is a two-storey structure comprised of RC column and beam construction with composite cladding finish. Construction comprises concrete ground beams on CFA piles, blockwork rising walls, concrete floor slab, metal stud partitions internal walls, insulated composite cladding panels to external walls, pre-cast concrete first floor and roof slab, external double-glazed windows and doors, internal doors and screens, mechanical and electrical services, internal floor, wall, and ceiling finishes, flat roof finish, decoration internally, and associated external works. Im Falle der Kündigung aus wichtigem Grund hat der Auftragnehmer Anspruch auf Vergütung für die bis zum Wirksamwerden der Kündigung aufgrund des Vertrages erbrachten Leistungen. REPUBLIC OF TAJIKISTAN

TAJIKISTAN DIGITAL FOUNDATIONS PROJECT

Assignment Title: Consultancy Service for Advanced Digital Skills Trainings for 1,000 individuals
